name: Hotel Hassler
insider_take: Perched majestically atop the Spanish Steps, Hotel Hassler reigns as Rome's most prestigious address, where Hollywood royalty and world leaders have made history for over a century.
whats_special: This legendary palace hotel occupies the most coveted location in Rome, directly above the famous Spanish Steps with unparalleled views of the Eternal City. The Hassler has been family-owned for five generations and houses one of Europe's most exclusive rooftop restaurants, Imàgo, boasting a Michelin star and panoramic vistas of St. Peter's Dome.
pro_tip: Book a Trinità dei Monti suite for the ultimate experience—these rooms offer private terraces overlooking the Spanish Steps and are often used for exclusive fashion shoots during Rome's high season.
dont_miss: The hotel's private rooftop garden terrace at sunset, where you can sip champagne while gazing across Rome's seven hills. Also explore the nearby Villa Medici and take the hotel's complimentary Rolls-Royce for shopping along Via del Corso—a perk reserved for suite guests.
pros: Prime location atop Spanish Steps with panoramic city views
Michelin-starred rooftop restaurant Imàgo with stunning terrace
Legendary luxury service and personalized attention
Historic charm combined with refined Italian elegance
Walking distance to major attractions like Trevi Fountain and Villa Borghese
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
Historic building with traditional room layouts may feel compact
